'''Phraig''' was a bland, pale [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]]. It was eaten as a breakfast [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], usually served steamed and mixed with bits of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="BP" />
